claim: The iPhone 12 won’t come with earphones and a charging adapter.

new_qa.question: Apple announced that the iPhone 12 series would not include earphones (such as EarPods) in the box.
new_qa.answer: Based on the documented record, Apple did officially announce on October 13, 2020, that the iPhone 12 series would not include EarPods in the retail packaging.

new_qa.question: Apple announced that the iPhone 12 series would not include a charging adapter in the box.
new_qa.answer: Apple officially announced on October 13, 2020, that the iPhone 12 series would not include a charging adapter in the box, attributing this decision to environmental reasons such as reducing carbon emissions and enabling smaller, more efficient packaging.

new_qa.question: The iPhone 12 series was released in October 2020.
new_qa.answer: The iPhone 12 series was officially launched on October 14, 2020, as confirmed at Apple's event on that date.
